BRCGS önerisi: A general procedure shoul: BRCGS recommendation: A general procedure should be in place to capture affected product in the event that controls are not utilised or only partially utilised. This usually includes identifying the affected product, isolating it, and determining outcomes, which may include preventing it from entering into commerce where required.
BRCGS önerisi: Add verification of light: BRCGS recommendation: Add verification of light levels to internal audit checklist. Consider (although not compulsory) including a measure, target levels, and device.
BRCGS önerisi: Adjust organisational cha: BRCGS recommendation: Adjust organisational chart to comply.
BRCGS önerisi: Adjust record retention p: BRCGS recommendation: Adjust record retention policy to identify relevant records and maintain for a minimum of 2 years.
BRCGS önerisi: Adjust transport service: BRCGS recommendation: Adjust transport service provider contracts as necessary, to include adherence to FSMA requirements.
BRCGS önerisi: All control-related recor: BRCGS recommendation: All control-related records should be reviewed within 7 days by the designated individual. Sufficient backup should be in place for the main PCQI to ensure coverage in case of absence. Record reviews should be dated.
BRCGS önerisi: All transport employees r: BRCGS recommendation: All transport employees responsible for the product will require adequate training on the relevant FSMA regulations (primarily those identified in this section).
BRCGS önerisi: Corrective action procedu: BRCGS recommendation: Corrective action procedures within the food defence plan should include failure of, or failure to utilise, mitigation strategies.
BRCGS önerisi: Do not accept the supplie: BRCGS recommendation: Do not accept the supplier verification activities as described in 21 CFR § 117.415 and listed in the guidance above. Ensure this is documented in the raw material supplier approval and monitoring procedures.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure monitoring and ver: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure monitoring and verification procedures for the supplier and raw material approval and performance monitoring system include the documentation and review of alternative verification activities for specific suppliers as outlined by the regulation and in the guidance above. Ensure review of records as applicable to the supply-chain program within a reasonable timeframe by (or under the oversight of) the preventive controls qualified individual.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure procedures for con: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure procedures for controlling non-conforming product include reconditioning protocols in accordance with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure procedures for raw: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure procedures for raw material acceptance, monitoring and management include inspection activities to ensure raw materials and other ingredients are clean and suitable for processing. This must include washing of raw materials or ingredients to remove soil or other contamination as necessary and procedures to maintain product safety and quality during storage. Where water is reused for washing, rinsing, or conveying food, effective measures must be taken to ensure the water does not cause allergen cross-contact or increase the level of contamination.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure procedures for sup: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure procedures for supplier approval and monitoring include a definition for a qualified auditor that is in line with that of 21 CFR § 117. The procedures should also indicate if alternate onsite audit activities (as described in the guidance above) are acceptable.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure procedures related: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure procedures related to the management of surplus food and products for animal feed include measures to prevent contamination of human food by-products for use as animal food during holding and distribution, including appropriate storage and shipping containers, identification, and labelling.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure site’s record rete: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure site’s record retention policy includes identification of relevant documents, and that they are retained for a minimum of 2 years.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that procedures to: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure that procedures to maintain product safety and quality during storage include measures for protecting food in installed outdoor bulk vessels.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that records ident: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure that records identify all bullet points, specifically the site and traceability to specific product lots.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that the record re: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure that the record retention policy identifies key transport-related records, and that they are maintained for a minimum of 12 months.
BRCGS recommendation: Ensure that the record retention policy identifies which records are to be kept, and that they are kept for at least 2 years.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that the risk asse: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure that the risk assessment (either embedded in the HACCP risk analysis or as a separate analysis) includes risks from economic adulteration, environmental pathogens, and unintentional contamination. Specifically add ‘radiological’ to the risk category covering chemical risks.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure that the risks uni: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure that the risks unique to animal food (dependent on destination use or potential) are identified and mitigated.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure the designated PCQ: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure the designated PCQI has oversight of verifications and that they are completed within 7 days of creation.
BRCGS önerisi: Ensure the raw material r: BRCGS recommendation: Ensure the raw material risk assessment identifies all raw materials or ingredients in which a hazard will be controlled by the supplier and is one for which there is a reasonable probability that exposure to the hazard will result in serious adverse health consequences or death to humans. The requirement to conduct an onsite audit of suppliers of the applicable raw materials and ingredients before using them, and at least annually thereafter should be included in the supplier and raw material approval and performance monitoring procedures. The procedures should also describe when written determination that other verification activities and/or less frequent onsite auditing of the supplier provide adequate assurance that the hazards are controlled would be appropriate.
BRCGS önerisi: Identify backflow prevent: BRCGS recommendation: Identify backflow prevention risk areas and devices. Add to periodic check program (at a minimum, recommend annual). Ensure disposal of sewage into adequate sewerage system or other adequate means.
BRCGS önerisi: Indication of potential s: BRCGS recommendation: Indication of potential sources of and contamination by pathogens represent the key area of focus for the training.
BRCGS önerisi: Note that food defence mu: BRCGS recommendation: Note that food defence must assess both external and internal threats. This requirement (clause 13.3.2) is in alignment with 4.2.1- 4.2.4.
BRCGS önerisi: Obtain a copy of the FDA: BRCGS recommendation: Obtain a copy of the FDA Defect Action Level document. If ingredients or finished products are included in the DAL, ensure specifications at a minimum meet the expectations listed.
BRCGS önerisi: Of specific note, where a: BRCGS recommendation: Of specific note, where a supplier controls a specific hazard (which is not controlled post receiving, as in the case of cooked chicken), the supplier must be approved via audit.
BRCGS önerisi: Procedures for managed tr: BRCGS recommendation: Procedures for managed transport equipment should include maintaining them in sanitary condition during use. Recommend adding this to driver training and/or contracts for logistics suppliers.
BRCGS önerisi: Procedures should include: BRCGS recommendation: Procedures should include not only initial verification of cleanliness, but also the expectation to maintain these conditions during transport.
BRCGS önerisi: Recommend including verif: BRCGS recommendation: Recommend including verification or assessment of mitigation strategies into internal audit systems.
BRCGS recommendation: Recommend including verification procedures for all mitigation strategies in internal audit activities.
BRCGS önerisi: Recommend specifically ad: BRCGS recommendation: Recommend specifically adding verification of seam and weld integrity, and assessment of corrosion to post-cleaning or preoperational inspections. This should form part of the training for the individuals who perform these checks.
BRCGS önerisi: Regardless of how many ti: BRCGS recommendation: Regardless of how many times a required control is applied prior to being received at a site, the receiving site is responsible for verifying that the control has been applied. As an example, when cooked chicken is received (with no additional kill step required by the receiving facility), the site where the cook step takes place must be included in supplier verification, specifically verifying controls around the cook step.
BRCGS önerisi: Responsibility for approp: BRCGS recommendation: Responsibility for appropriate transport equipment shall be undertaken by the site or embedded into the contract for service suppliers.
BRCGS önerisi: Risk matrices should take: BRCGS recommendation: Risk matrices should take into account ease of access to open product. In general, access restriction to processing and storage areas will manage external but not internal threats. Internal threats may be managed by a combination of access restriction, employee vetting, restriction of materials entering the area (limiting what employees can bring into production area), and oversight.
BRCGS önerisi: Sample and test methodolo: BRCGS recommendation: Sample and test methodology should follow industry-accepted practices, and reference to such practices should be part of the procedure.
BRCGS önerisi: Sample sites and frequenc: BRCGS recommendation: Sample sites and frequency of testing should be based on a risk assessment. Corrective action should include product disposition in the case of positive results, immediate correction (i.e. , reclean), and corrective action (i.e. , reassessment of cleaning procedures).
BRCGS önerisi: Similar to the CCPs, haza: BRCGS recommendation: Similar to the CCPs, hazards requiring a preventive control or significant hazards should be identified. BRCGS önerisi: Specific attention must b: BRCGS recommendation: Specific attention must be paid to approval prior to receiving materials. It is not acceptable to receive on hold, then approve.
BRCGS önerisi: Specific attention to be: BRCGS recommendation: Specific attention to be paid to the last two bullet points, ensuring site identification and lot code where applicable.

BRCGS önerisi: The individual or team re: BRCGS recommendation: The individual or team responsible for developing and reviewing the food defence plan should be able to justify their expertise in the subject. Recommend some form of training.
BRCGS önerisi: The recall plan should in: BRCGS recommendation: The recall plan should include the identified bullet points. The effectiveness of the plans should be assessed during the site mock recall.
BRCGS önerisi: The senior manager must r: BRCGS recommendation: The senior manager must review the food safety plan or be present during the annual management review.
BRCGS önerisi: The site senior manager m: BRCGS recommendation: The site senior manager must review (or be present during the review, as in the annual management review) the food defence plan.
BRCGS önerisi: The site shall not engage: BRCGS recommendation: The site shall not engage in any financial conflicts of interest that affect the results of the verification activities linked with raw materials and other ingredients, and these must not be relate payment to the results of the activity.
BRCGS önerisi: The supply-chain procedur: BRCGS recommendation: The supply-chain procedure shall include the receipt of the raw material or other ingredients from unapproved suppliers, preventive control management actions and responsibilities for the review of records and reanalysis of the food safety plan.
BRCGS önerisi: There is a strong recomme: BRCGS recommendation: There is a strong recommendation that at least one individual per site undertakes the recognised FSPCA PCQI training. Alternative training and qualifications that focus on food safety expertise, as well as an understanding of FSMA rules, may be acceptable. Ensure that there is written justification for the review of records of monitoring and corrective actions within a timeframe that exceeds 7 working days, as well as a determination that reanalysis can be completed, and additional preventive controls validated, as appropriate to the nature of the preventive control and its role in the facilities food safety system, in a timeframe that exceeds the first 90 calendar days of production of the applicable food.

BRCGS önerisi: US-based (and those cross: BRCGS recommendation: US-based (and those crossing into the US) transporters should comply with the relevant FSMA regulations embedded in their contracts.
BRCGS önerisi: Where hazards are identif: BRCGS recommendation: Where hazards are identified, adequate controls must be in place. Such controls may include precautionary labelling (labelling includes specifications) for subsequent users, even where the site’s finished product will be an ingredient at a different site. As an example, untreated flour could advise customers of the need to cook prior to consumer consumption.
